name: Cliffside Cubing Billings 2025
information: Welcome back to Billings for a great day of cubing with Montana's best! The cubing community, particularly in Montana, is a great group of people and we encourage everyone to come compete or just watch regardless of your speed or age. Lunch will be provided for this competition and is included in your registration fee. See the tab about lunch for more information. All proceeds for this competition will go to the Yellowstone 4H Exchange Group. We thank them for supporting this competition! You MUST read the required tabs on the website before registering for the competition. These tabs pertain to your responsibilities as a competitior.
